0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) head to Indiana for their fifth game of the season, currently on a one-game losing streak, while the Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East, 1.5 games back in the 3rd in the Central) are also on a one-game losing streak. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Joel Embiid, VJ Edgecombe, and Jabari Walker are day-to-day with knee, heel, and abdomen issues. Indiana is without Andrew Nembhard, Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, and T.J. McConnell, and the teams have no games yet this season, though the 76ers won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10.
